subject.title: CLI-backend empty_response fallback restart kills unrelated concurrent background Agent-tool sessions

question: Should this issue be resolved by the provider-scoped reset fix alone, with automatic recovery of stalled background runs tracked as a separate product design?
rationale: Provider-scoped cleanup repairs an existing isolation expectation, but automatically resuming an interrupted agent can replay tool work and requires a deliberate product safety contract.

options.title: Land scoped isolation; design recovery separately
options.body: Review the open reset-scope fix as the bug repair, then create or retain a separate design discussion for safe orphaned-run recovery.

options.title: Require recovery in this issue
options.body: Keep the issue open until a single design and implementation covers both scoped cleanup and an explicitly safe automatic-resume policy.

recommendation.title: Land scoped isolation; design recovery separately
recommendation.body: Review the open reset-scope fix as the bug repair, then create or retain a separate design discussion for safe orphaned-run recovery.
